name: @borjie/belief-engine
description: Epistemic belief layer (LP-17/18). Pure belief store + convince-loop (revise only when confidence delta > 0.25; split 0.05-0.25; no-op below), DPO preference-learner, LinUCB contextual bandit, Mem0 ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP semantics, and a nightly Pearson belief×outcome correlation pass. Ports-based — inject a store; never writes beliefs directly. Ported from LITFIN litfin-ai/learning + learning.
